question: From which bodily points may the dividing line of the form begin?
premises: One possible starting point is the middle of the forehead at the nose-tip.
An alternative starting point is given as the middle of the breast.
The particle vā presents these as options.
inference: The iconographic division may begin from either specified bodily point.
uncertainties: The initial element vetu- in vetustanamadhyamāt is unclear in meaning.
plain_english: The line may begin from the middle of the forehead at the tip of the nose, or from the middle of the breast.
